title: The Book button opens booking on a Space that has bookable services, instead of an empty membership page

source.ref: Space booking audit 2026-11-21 (project thread: Make Space booking as robust as Calendly)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-21 on production: /spaces/house-of-fates/book (10 active services) and /spaces/danny-kenduck/book (2 services) both render 'Become a member'; Danny's page says 'No membership tiers yet'. EntityCta picks the surface from the Focus alone (lib/spaces/cta-kind.ts ctaKindFor); the P0.5 setup prompt only helps the owner. A visitor pressing Book now on a Space that has services and hours meets a dead end. Fix: when the Space has at least one active service and one window, booking leads (or the membership surface carries a Book a time door). Expected lift: every Book now press on these Spaces, today all lost.

DONE 2026-11-21: EntityCta (components/widgets/entity/entity-cta.tsx) now reads readPublicBookingSetup once when the Focus does not already lead with booking, and lib/spaces/cta-kind.ts adds two pure rules, hasBookableServices (an active service AND a weekly window) and bookPageKind (a bookable Space leads with booking whatever its Focus says; otherwise the Focus picks, unchanged). /spaces/<slug>/book on a membership-Focus Space with services and hours now opens Book a session instead of Become a member. The sitemap tab reader (lib/spaces/discovery.ts, SCAN-787) uses the same rule through two more batched presence reads (space_service_types active, space_availability), so /book is advertised exactly when the page leads with booking. Tests: lib/spaces/cta-kind.test.ts (new) and a BOOK-002 case in lib/spaces/discovery.test.ts.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
